subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
2.
As per the understanding of CA Rajesh, which of the below options, falls
within the scope of audit of financial statements?
(A)  Reliability and sufficiency of financial information.
(B)  Responsibility of preparation and presentation of financial information.
(C)  Expertise in authentication of documents.
(D)  Duties outside scope of competence of auditor.
(2 Marks)
